violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WAS NOT THERE AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION. CFM CERTIFICATION WAS ALSO EXPIRED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A NON EXPIRED CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE IS NEEDED AND A CFM MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. EHS WILL CONTACT PIC IN 10 DAYS TO SEE IF THEY HAVE OBTAINED A NON EXPIRED CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. A CAN OF ROACH AND ANT RAID WAS FOUND IN THE KITCHEN BEING USED TO SPRAY FOR PESTS.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HOME USE PESTICIDES MAY NOT BE USED IN A COMMERCIAL KITCHEN. PIC THREW AWAY CAN OF RAID AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: 2025 Fairfax County Health Department Food Establishment Permit was not posted were the public can see and EHS could not find where its located
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PLEASE POST THE 2025 FAIRFAX COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT FOOD ESTABLISHMENT PERMIT WHERE THE PUBLIC CAN SEE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: CFM was not present throughout the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE MADE SURE A CFM IS PRESENT AT FACILITY AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located in the back of house is blocked, by a prep table, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PLEASE MOVE THE PREP TABLE OUT OF THE WAY OF THE HAND SINK SO IT IS ALWAYS AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PLEASE ONLY STORE CHEMICALS IN DESIGNATED SPOT AND DO NOT LEAVE THEM HANGING OFF BOXES, ON THE ICE MACHINE, AND HANGING OFF OF STORAGE WRACKS. CHEMICALS CAN NOT BE STORED WITH FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE OBTAIN A FOOD THERMOMETER WITH A PROBE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL FOOD AND FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS ARE NOT BEING STORED ON THE FLOOR WITH A MINIMUM OF 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: An ice scoop in the ice machine and an ice scoop in the cold holding Cambro unit were being stored incorrectly, directly in the ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PLEASE BEGIN STORING ICE SCOOPS WITH THE HANDLE UP TO NOT TOUCH THE ICE OR IN A CONTAINER STORED OUTSIDE OF EACH ICE MACHINE THAT CAN BE EASILY CLEANED AND ORGANIZED.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean blenders were being stored to dry on a cold holding Cambro. They were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL CLEAN EQUIPMENT IS BEING STORED IN BETWEEN USES IN AN AREA FREE FROM CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard is being used to line shelving units as well as create fake shelves for food and dry stock storage.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PLEASE REMOVE ALL CARDBOARD FROM SHELVING UNITS IN FACILITY. CARDBOARD CANNOT BE EASILY CLEAN AND CAN EASILY BECOME SOILD.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: Multiple containers being used to store food are not food grade safe and should not be used for storage of foods.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE OBTAIN FOOD GRADE SAFE OF APPROVED NSF CONTAINERS TO STORE FOODS IN. PLEASE OBTAIN FOOD GRADE SAFE CONTAINERS BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: The chest freezer in BOH is being used as a prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL FOOD PREP AREAS ARE CONSTRUCTED PROPERLY AND FOOD IS NOT EASILY EXPOSED TO POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE OBTAIN A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the serving counter is not maintained in good repair and has large holes on the side of it.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE FIX THE HOLES IN THE SERVING COUNTER TO PREVENT ANY POTENTIAL PEST OR DIRT AND DEBRIS TO ENTER THE HOLES.
